input.title: Do not allow drag to be initiated in scroll zone
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- This is a long thought that keeps going and going until it wraps onto two lines and becomes a multiline thought.
```

Tap and hold the text of the thought in the far right scroll zone, then begin dragging.

## Current Behavior

Drag-and-drop is allowed.

## Expected Behavior

Drag-and-drop should be disabled in the scroll zone. 

This will help prevent false negatives when the user is trying to scroll. The scroll zone is quite small now, so there's plenty of space on the rest of the screen for the user to drag.
